command:
set -eu
umask 022
tmp_cfg=$(mktemp /etc/logrotate.d/inventory.XXXXXX)
cat > "$tmp_cfg" <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 "$tmp_cfg"
chown root:root "$tmp_cfg"
mv "$tmp_cfg" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
restorecon /etc/logrotate.d/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- installed rule ---'
cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
printf '%s\n' '--- metadata ---'

printf '%s\n' '--- parser check ---'

command:
set -eu
state_file=$(mktemp /tmp/inventory-logrotate-state.XXXXXX)
exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
before_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf '%s\n' 'rotation-test-before' >&3
logrotate --force --state "$state_file" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
after_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf '%s\n' 'rotation-test-after' >&3
exec 3>&-
printf 'inode_before=%s inode_after=%s\n' "$before_inode" "$after_inode"
printf '%s\n' '--- active log ---'
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- compressed rotation listing ---'
ls -l /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
printf '%s\n' '--- rotated content tail ---'
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | tail -n 10
printf '%s\n' '--- timer state ---'
systemctl is-enabled logrotate.timer
systemctl is-active logrotate.timer
